description: Hypothesis: gathered expert inputs with adaptive tiles and fused online GQA attention improve the FP16-KV base prefill result (1245.3 tok/s) while preserving endpoint conformance, retrieval and cache correctness. Measure the merged implementation with --tuned-prefill, the same DFlash2 draft, FP16 target/draft KV, prefix caching and 32K context. Several kernels change together; no single-kernel attribution is claimed. Online attention rounds block-local exponentials to FP16 with FP32 accumulators, softmax statistics and recurrent state; generated tokens and speculative acceptance may change. Run all seven tests with the full profile and inherit the existing goal thresholds. Pin the latest evaluator repository revision; its definition and driver hashes are unchanged from the base.
